paper_title: How Knowledge Popularity Influences and Enhances LLM Knowledge Boundary   Perception
caption: The QA performance, confidence, and alignment of ChatGPT under different question popularity.

model_annotations.Bulgarian: Тази линейна диаграма илюстрира промяната в три метрики — точност (Accuracy), увереност (Confidence) и съгласуваност (Alignment) — на модела ChatGPT при различна популярност на въпросите, измерена по оста X. Оста X, означена като „Question Popularity“, е линейна и обхваща диапазона от 5 до 26, с етикети на интервали от 5 (5, 10, 15, 20, 25). Оста Y, означена като „Values“, е също линейна, обхващаща диапазона от 0.55 до 1.00, с етикети на интервали от 0.05 (0.55, 0.60, ..., 1.00), без изрично посочени единици. Три линии представят отделните метрики: синя линия с кръгли маркери за „Accuracy“, зелена линия с триъгълни маркери за „Confidence“ и червена линия с квадратни маркери за „Alignment“. Линията за „Accuracy“ започва при стойност 0.60 при популярност 5, спада до 0.60 при 6, след което постепенно расте до 0.88 при 26, с леко колебание между 10 и 15. Линията за „Confidence“ започва при 0.93 при 5, остава висока и стабилна в диапазона 0.92–0.97 до 26, с леко нарастване в края. Линията за „Alignment“ започва при 0.73 при 5, спада до 0.68 при 6, след което расте постепенно до 0.90 при 26, с леки колебания между 8 и 14. Всички три линии показват общ тренд на нарастване с увеличаване на популярността на въпросите, като „Confidence“ остава най-висока и най-стабилна през целия диапазон.
model_annotations.English: The line plot, titled “ChatGPT on Songs,” illustrates the trends in Accuracy, Confidence, and Alignment of ChatGPT as a function of Question Popularity, ranging from 5 to 26 on the x-axis, which is labeled “Question Popularity” and uses a linear scale with major tick marks at intervals of 5. The y-axis, labeled “Values,” spans from 0.55 to 1.00 in linear increments of 0.05. Three distinct lines represent the metrics: Accuracy (blue circles connected by a solid line) begins at approximately 0.66 at popularity 5, dips to 0.60 at popularity 6, then generally increases to 0.88 at popularity 26. Confidence (green triangles connected by a solid line) starts near 0.93 at popularity 5, fluctuates slightly but remains high, peaking around 0.97 at popularity 10 and 18, and ends at 0.98 at popularity 26. Alignment (red squares connected by a solid line) begins at 0.73 at popularity 5, drops to 0.68 at popularity 6, rises to 0.86 at popularity 12, dips to 0.78 at popularity 14, and climbs steadily to 0.90 at popularity 26. All three metrics show an overall upward trend with increasing question popularity, though Accuracy and Alignment exhibit more volatility than Confidence.
model_annotations.German: This line chart, titled “ChatGPT on Songs,” illustrates the variation in three metrics—Accuracy, Confidence, and Alignment—of ChatGPT’s responses as a function of Question Popularity, which ranges from approximately 5 to 26 along the x-axis. The x-axis, labeled “Question Popularity,” uses a linear scale with tick marks at intervals of 5 (5, 10, 15, 20, 25) and no specified units. The y-axis, labeled “Values,” spans from 0.55 to 1.00 in linear increments of 0.05, representing normalized performance or perception scores. The blue line with circular markers, labeled “Accuracy,” begins at 0.67 at popularity 5, dips to 0.60 at popularity 6, then rises to 0.75 at 9, peaks at 0.82 at 11, drops to 0.72 at 14, and ends at 0.89 at 26. The green line with triangular markers, labeled “Confidence,” starts at 0.93 at popularity 5, fluctuates slightly between 0.92 and 0.96 through popularity 14, and gradually increases to 0.98 at 26. The red line with square markers, labeled “Alignment,” begins at 0.73 at popularity 5, drops to 0.68 at 6, rises to 0.75 at 8, peaks at 0.86 at 11, dips to 0.77 at 14, and ends at 0.90 at 26. All three lines show an overall upward trend with varying degrees of fluctuation across the popularity range.
